4826-5531-5694-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-5531-5694-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-5531-5694-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4687-5296-6006.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4687-5296-6006.description:
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4029-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

864-1987-3075.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
864-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
864-1987-3075.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-3075.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-527-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-3499-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3499-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-3185-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
997-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

4499-7052-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

628-5231-7215.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1308-4017-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4017-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4050-4506-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4506-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

539-6798-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1400-4050-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4050-4619.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.

4013-4659-4985-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

240-526-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.
240-526-6798.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

2060-3334-3525-3574.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3334-3525-3574.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3334-3525-3574.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

2382-2921-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-2921-5659--33.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5909-6117.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library.
Cast Shared Trauma by paying {B}, and then choosing to pay an additional {6}, milling the remainder of each library.
Move to the next opponent's turn, causing them to lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining opponent.

2511-2527-3143-3464.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-2527-3143-3464.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3933-4929-5479-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-5902.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

678-4050-4094-4151.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4094-4151.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
678-4050-4094-4151.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, doubling all tokens you create this turn.
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4790-4891-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
2034-4790-4891-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Atsushi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose Atsushi's first mode.

307-2327-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Moon-Circuit Hacker or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
307-2327-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Moon-Circuit Hacker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

618-1872-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

184-851-4682.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
184-851-4682.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-851-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

890-1056-2410.notablePrerequisites:
Araumi of the Dead Tide and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
You have an additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
890-1056-2410.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Myr Galvanizer encore until end of turn.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer's encore ability by paying {3} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate a Myr Galvanizer token by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping all other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.
